definitions: To fish by letting the bait bob lightly on the surface of the water.
To make a small hole or a series of small holes in the ground, especially for planting seeds or seedlings.
To make a small, quick dip or bobbing motion.
examples: He likes to dib for trout in the stream.
She used a tool to dib holes for the new plants.
The child would dib his finger in the paint.
The boat would dib gently in the calm water.
